name: Keyoxide - Proxy
description:
Keyoxide is a privacy-friendly tool to create and verify decentralized online identities.  
        
        This is the proxy interface. It is recommended to also run a Keyoxide - Web container alongside it.
requires: Requires a Keyoxide - Web instance to be running alongside this container.

variables.name: Domain
variables.description: The domain on which the instance is hosted

variables.name: ActivityPub - URL
variables.description: The URL of the simulated ActivityPub account (e.g. https://KEYOXIDE_WEB_DOMAIN/user/keyoxide)

variables.name: ActivityPub - Private Key
variables.description: The private key used to simulate an ActivityPub account and sign HTTP requests

variables.name: IRC Nickname
variables.description: The nick of your IRC verifier account

variables.name: Matrix - Access Token
variables.description: The access token of your Matrix verifier account

variables.name: Matrix - Instance
variables.description: The URL of the Matrix instance your verifier account is hosted on

variables.name: Matrix - Room
variables.description: The ID of the Matrix room your verifier account will use

variables.name: Telegram - Token
variables.description: The bot token of your Telegram verifier bot

variables.name: XMPP - Service
variables.description: The hostname of your XMPP verifier account

variables.name: XMPP - Username
variables.description: The username of your XMPP verifier account

variables.name: XMPP - Password
variables.description: The password of your XMPP verifier account

variables.name: Act as Web
variables.description: Disable web interface functionality. Not recommended to change.

author: nwithan8
